meta.name: prioritize
meta.description: Choose up to three immediate priorities from competing initiatives. Use when everything is urgent and the customer needs a defensible order with explicit deferrals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一堆都喊紧急的事项排出先后,明确先做哪几件、哪些暂缓
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上事情都标着紧急,却需要给出一份站得住脚的先后顺序
copy.tagline_en: Rank competing initiatives into a defensible order and name what gets deferred
copy.fit_line_en: For you if everything feels urgent and you need a defensible order for what comes first

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会从互相竞争的多项待办里挑出最多三个立刻要做的优先事项,给出一个能站得住脚的排序,并明确指出哪些被推迟。它直接用你提供的上下文工作,不需要额外的项目文件夹或初始化。
howto.when: 当所有事情都显得紧急,而你需要一个有依据的先后顺序、且要写明哪些暂缓时触发。若由 @fde 调用,会复用其当前的脱敏信息包和范围。
howto.what_en: After install, Claude picks up to three immediate priorities from competing initiatives and returns a defensible order with explicit deferrals, working directly from the context you supply — no engagement folder or setup needed.
howto.when_en: Use when everything is urgent and the customer needs a defensible order with explicit deferrals. If called by @fde, it reuses that packet and scope.

say_en.text: Everything's urgent — pick up to three for now and name what we defer.
say_en.note: You get three priorities plus deferrals

say_en.text: Customer wants a defensible order: three priorities plus explicit deferrals.
Rank this list, keep three to do now, and note why the rest are deferred.
